newsitem.title: USA: Renal Treatment buys Binz Supply Co.
newsitem.headline: Renal Treatment buys Binz Supply Co.

text.p: Renal Treatment Centers Inc said Monday it acquired Binz Supply Co, a dialysis supply company, and entered a definitive agreement to buy the Plaza Dialysis Unit, an outpatient dialysis facility.
Both are located in Houston, Texas, a statement from Renal Treatment Centers said.

In connection with the Plaza Dialysis Unit transaction, Renal Treatment said it entered an agreement, effective September 1, to manage the facility until the expected closing of the transaction in January, 1997.
Plaza Dialysis Unit, which provides care to about 210 outpatients, opened in 1986, the statement said.
Renal Treatment's stock rose 2-3/4 at 33-5/8 on Monday.
